cause: Low direct vocabulary overlap despite possible semantic match.
automatic_strategy: Apply semantic lexicon, morphology normalization, and ontology relation cues.
training_use: Do not reject solely for low surface overlap; rerank with semantic score.
manual_review_policy: Review only if semantic+ontology score remains low or target is broad.
confidence_after_fix: high/medium if gold-like semantic relation confirmed.

cause: Candidate chosen mainly by poem/commentary order.
automatic_strategy: Use global sequence alignment, neighbouring span constraints, reverse-order alignment, and relation cue confirmation.
training_use: Order-only support cannot become positive high-confidence training data.
manual_review_policy: Manual review if no relation cue supports the ordered target.
confidence_after_fix: medium/high only if neighbour + relation cue agree.

automatic_strategy: Expand entity annotation for deity epithets, thalam variants, sacred objects, body parts, myth events.
training_use: Recover anchors through hierarchy expansion before review.
manual_review_policy: Review if expanded entity system still finds no anchor.
confidence_after_fix: upgrade if entity+ontology relation is accepted.

cause: Best and second-best target spans are too close.
automatic_strategy: Resolve with global assignment, neighbor evidence, target granularity penalty, gold pattern reranking.
training_use: Do not choose raw best score when margin below threshold.
manual_review_policy: Manual review if margin < 0.05 or assignment conflicts with local best.
confidence_after_fix: medium if resolved but broad; high if exact compact target selected.

training_use: Positive gold; use for thresholds and feature calibration.

cause: Weak overall score, often surface+entity+relation all weak.
automatic_strategy: Try full hardening stack; otherwise leave in review/negative set.
